hero.subtitle: Across LATAM, most transformations stall between the decision and the operation. CIRA connects them: strategy, the right solution, and real adoption, with AI in every phase.

ceo.quote: "In most organizations the problem isn't strategy or technology. It's that no one takes responsibility for connecting the decision to the execution. CIRA exists to close exactly that gap."

ceo.photoAlt: Jackson Bohorquez, CEO of Cyrrus Consulting Services

panels.eyebrow: When the plan never reaches operations
panels.title: Strategic Consulting
panels.description: If the plan stayed in the deck, the problem wasn't the strategy — it was having no one to execute it. We build it, select the right solution, and execute, with one party accountable end to end.

panels.eyebrow: When AI stays stuck in isolated pilots
panels.title: Enterprise Artificial Intelligence
panels.description: Before adding another AI tool, know who decides, who audits, and what data it can touch. We govern that layer over your real processes — not sell you another catalog of chatbots.

panels.eyebrow: When the team doesn't adopt what was implemented
panels.title: Change Management & Leadership
panels.description: A well-implemented system nobody uses isn't a successful project. We train your managers so the change holds after we leave — without depending on us.

panels.eyebrow: When your site doesn't reflect what the company is worth
panels.title: Web Development & SEO
panels.description: A site no one finds, and positioning that leads to a door that doesn't convert, generate no business. We build the site as a business asset and make it visible where your client searches — and where they ask an AI.
